response: The Senior Staff Association of Nigerian Universities has given the federal government a one-month ultimatum to wrap up the renegotiation of the 2009 agreement with the non-teaching university unions, or face an indefinite nationwide strike. This came from resolutions at their 54th National Executive Council meeting. These union threats amount to a direct attack on authority and social order, holding the education of our youth hostage while undermining the stability that families and the nation depend on. Rather than showing personal responsibility and respect for established institutions, they are choosing disruption that weakens cultural continuity and national strength. The government must stand firm and prioritize order over caving to these tactics.
